use default

let biggest_factorial = 18

factorial(n: int) -> long =>
    (2::n) |> reduce(1L, (product: long, i: int) => product * cast long(i))

multiples(value: long, largest: int, limit: long) -> Pipe[long] is
    yield value

    for i in 2::largest do
        if value <= limit / factorial(i) then
            yield in multiples(value * factorial(i), i, limit)
        fi
    od
si

decompose(value: long, largest: int) -> LIST[int]? is
    if value == 1L then
        return LIST()
    fi

    for i in reverse(2::largest) do
        if value % factorial(i) == 0L then
            if let rest = decompose(value / factorial(i), i) then
                rest.insert(0, i)

                return rest
            fi
        fi
    od

    return null
si

as_factorials(value: long) -> string =>
    if let factors = decompose(value, biggest_factorial) then
        factors
            |> distinct()
            |> map((i: int) =>
                (let times = factors |> filter(f => f == i) |> count()
                 if times == 1 then "{i}!" else "{i}!^{times}" fi))
            |> join(" x ")
    else
        "not a product of factorials"
    fi

let limit = 1L << 53

let numbers = multiples(1L, biggest_factorial, limit)
    |> distinct()
    |> sort()
    |> collect()

write_line("the first 50 Jordan-Polya numbers:")

numbers
    |> take(50)
    |> chunk(10)
    |> each(row =>
        write_line(row |> map((n: long) => "{n,7}") |> join("")))

let below_a_hundred_million = numbers
    |> take_while(n => n < 100000000L)
    |> reduce(1L, (largest: long, n: long) => n)

write_line("")
write_line("largest below 100 million: {below_a_hundred_million}"
    " = {as_factorials(below_a_hundred_million)}")
write_line("")

[800, 1050, 1800, 2800, 3800]
    |> each((n: int) =>
        (let value = numbers[n - 1]
         write_line("{n,5}: {value,17} = {as_factorials(value)}")))
